title: Create one Account-scoped Client through the shared operation contract

requirements.invariant: A create intent preallocates one stable opaque ClientID inside one immutable Account and supplies one required current display name; display text is not identity, relationship or authorization evidence, and two Clients may retain equal names as distinct IDs.

Client creation is a distinct operation that may later supply authoritative identity to Project creation; it cannot rename/archive/merge a Client, edit copied Project client text or reassign a Project, so O-025 remains fully open.
CreateClient expresses one business intent through typed Ledger values and exposes no arbitrary field map, collection/path/SQL string, generic CRUD, Client merge/correction or backend SDK type.

The Client payload is bound to exactly one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID and finite client-created time through the shared operation fingerprint and receipt lifecycle; Client creation defines no competing queue, retry, result or rejection semantics.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral Client creation operation accepts the validated typed command and returns the shared OperationReceipt or a stable failure; local command validation never substitutes for trusted membership/capability authorization at the later server boundary.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the Firebase app remains unchanged and no Client table, handler, RLS, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ClientCreationDraft owns exact Account, actor, operation-contract, preallocated Client and validated display-name intent plus finite capture time; the draft contains no copied Project clientName or lifecycle mutation.

CreateClientPayload contains only stable ClientID and ClientDisplayName; CreateClientCommand binds it to the shared OperationEnvelope, derives the exact Client subject and fingerprint, permits no caller-authored preconditions and revalidates all derived evidence on decode.

ClientCreationOperating is the narrow backend-neutral operation port returning the shared OperationReceipt; command receipt validation requires the exact OperationID and exposes no authoritative Client row/result claim.

ClientCreationFailure exposes stable bounded time, binding, precondition, subject, fingerprint, receipt, local-acceptance and malformed-encoding codes while reusing the existing ClientDisplayName and shared operation validators.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates no clients table, account foreign key, name/lifecycle/audit column, uniqueness rule, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative CreateClient handler, membership/capability check, locking, audit timestamp, idempotency storage, conflict result or server row creation exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/actor binding is not authorization. No membership predicate, grant, WITH CHECK policy or cross-tenant database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Client table, optimistic projection, upload connector or synchronized visibility/readiness claim is defined.

items: The complete command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, Client subject and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Same-name/different-Client commands remain distinct, while changed Account, actor, contract, payload, subject, preconditions, fingerprint or receipt OperationID fails atomically without rebinding identity.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart or optimistic Client-row evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Client creation owns no attachment bytes/reference. Project hero media remains a separate later Project-setup handoff through the verified attachment receipt boundary.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Client form/picker, Project flow, current app service, MCP tool/schema, transport, contract-catalog entry or app/MCP parity claim is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase project.clientName is clustered, decoded or transformed and no source Client is synthesized. Later import must correlate every migrated Client explicitly and quarantine ambiguity.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no signal emission, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot create a visible or authoritative Client, authorize membership, choose Auth, rename/archive/merge, reassign a Project, define provider/schema/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-024/O-025, O-026, A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016, physical offline verification, production profiling and O-022 remain outside this command boundary.

verification.expected: A valid synthetic draft produces one typed exact-scope CreateClient command; two equal display names with distinct Client IDs remain distinct commands and neither text nor caller-authored lifecycle/correction state supplies identity.

Representative commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Client/name/time/subject/fingerprint evidence and no backend path, provider, credential or server-result claim.

Blank display input plus invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/payload/subject/preconditions/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through existing or Client-creation stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, same OperationID with changed Client payload is refused by the shared lifecycle, and a failing port returns no success receipt.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming server, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: The verified command/envelope structure remains reusable. D-006 settles stable Account-scoped Client identity and display-name non-authority, but O-043 now gates the exact new-submission boundary consumed through ClientDisplayName; this slice does not prove raw Swift/MCP/Postgres parity or stored-versus-submission representation. O-025 remains fully open because no rename/archive/merge/reassignment exists. The slice stops before physical durable storage, server apply, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access or cutover.
